# Joel Ivory

**Role:** Step-brother (Sheryle's son with Paul Ivory)
**Residence:** China (may have changed name)

---

## Family

| Relation | Name |
|----------|------|
| **Mother** | [[Sheryle Telfer (1961–?)]] |
| **Father** | [[Paul Ivory (1955–1996)]] |
| **Siblings** | [[Aaron Paul Ivory (1989–?)]], Jared Mitchell Ivory (1986–1994), [[Lauren Maree Ivory (1994–?)]] |

---

## Life Summary

Joel is Mark's step-brother — Sheryle's son from her first marriage to [[Paul Ivory (1955–1996)]]. He changed his name and has been living in China, out of contact with the family for years. Limited public information available.
